name: AgendaPro
long_description: AgendaPro is building Shopify for Beauty and Wellness businesses in Latam. We allow business owners to charge their customers online and easily schedule appointments.
one_liner: Shopify for Beauty and Wellness businesses in Latam

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: CEO & Co-founder of AgendaPro. Building the operating system for appointment-based businesses in Latin America — scheduling, AI agents, payments, and marketplace. 20,000+ merchants across 17 countries. Engineer at heart; still write SQL and ship code daily. Obsessed with data, patterns, and figuring out why things work.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
My name is Sebastián Hevia and I am Co-Founder and CTO at AgendaPro (YC W21). I am an accomplished coder and manager, building AgendaPro from scratch to leading multiple developers and I enjoy the most my responsibilities as Lead DevOps/Chief Architect. I mostly use Ruby on Rails, React, AWS and Kubernetes (EKS), and many other exciting technologies.

I also enjoy very much to play bass and mix recordings for my hobby band, and family time.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder and CPO of AgendaPro, working from Chile to help SMBs get better bookings and more sales.

Before founding AgendaPro I worked in an Insurance Company (Consorcio), buying positions in the electric and energy market.

Been related to software all my life and after college I went to Bangalore to Infosys's InStep program, where I develop a Blackberry app for Gas industry (feels ages today!!!). 

Father of 2 girls, frustrated guitarist and video gamer (I wish can say professional).

news.title: AgendaPro, “Shopify for beauty and wellness,” raises $3.7M
